**Ice Breaker** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* season.

A variant of the Harpoon Gun, the Ice Breaker deals secondary Cryo Damage. Enemies hit are slowed by 60% for six seconds (from ranged attacks) or twelve seconds (when bashed in melee combat.)

Targets killed by this weapon explode into frosty mist and leave behind a Cryo Hazard on the ground that lasts twelve seconds. Enemies entering a Cryo Hazard are slowed by 60% for three seconds and receive 5/10/15 (based on the weapon's level) Cryo Damage.

The item can be unlocked for crafting for 60 on page six of Season 21: *Gone Fission*.

 The weapon increases the movement and attack speed of targets rather than decreasing it. This is due to it missing an *Extend Duration on Recast* flag. This results in the slow effect stacking with every projectile fired, with the Flechettes mod increasing the number of projectiles (and thus the stacks) even further.

Ice Breaker appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* season.
